/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/mazlum-ka-matam-2.md\")
before = path.read_bytes().decode()
header, roman, body = re.fullmatch(r'(.*?romanLyrics: \\|-\\n)(.*?)(\\n---\\n.*)', before, re.S).groups()
replacements = {
    \"matam\": \"maatam\",
    \"Matam\": \"Maatam\",
    \"Sayyeda zainab\": \"Sayyeda Zainab\",
    \"Fatema zehra\": \"Fatema Zehra\",
    \"Zainulliba\": \"Zain-ul-Aba\",
    \"dil e zawwar\": \"dil-e-zawwaar\",
    \"Laashe\": \"Laasha\",
    \"sheh ke zainab\": \"sheh ke Zainab\",
    \"Dekhegi dunya\": \"Dekhe gi duniya\",
    \"tumhara\": \"tumhaara\",
    \"bhula na zamana\": \"bhula na zamaana\",
    \"azakhana\": \"aza khaana\",
    \"Sogh\": \"Sog\",
    \"rahega\": \"rahe ga\",
    \"Zahur-e-mehdi\": \"Zuhur-e-Mehdi\",
    \"pur soz\": \"pursoz\",
    \"darbar\": \"darb aar\".replace(\" \", \"\"),
    \"sarkar\": \"sarkaar\",
    \"unki\": \"un ki\",
    \"hamara\": \"hamaara\",
}
pattern = r\"\\b(?:\" + \"|\".join(map(re.escape, replacements)) + r\")\\b\"
updated = re.sub(pattern, lambda match: replacements[match[0]], roman)
original_lines = body.splitlines()[3:]
roman_lines = updated.splitlines()
assert len(original_lines) == len(roman_lines)
assert original_lines[0] == \"۱\" and roman_lines[0].strip() == \"1\"
assert all(line.startswith(\"  \") for line in roman_lines)
assert not re.search(r\"["'^'"\\x00-\\x7fṅṄ]\", updated)
path.write_bytes((header + updated + body).encode())
print(f\"Verified {len(roman_lines) - 1} verse pairs and matching stanza number. Urdu body and other metadata preserved.\")
